query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Analyze Salesforce opportunity pipeline data by discovering a custom field, retrieving stage metadata, querying filtered opportunity records, fetching stage-change history, and computing stage conversion and skip metrics.
query_ground_truth.query: query filtered Salesforce opportunity records and stage history
query_ground_truth.intent: Retrieve filtered opportunity records along with their stage-change history to compute conversion metrics.

requirement_groups.purpose: Execute a SOQL query to retrieve filtered opportunity records and related stage history

results.use_case: query filtered Salesforce opportunity records and stage history
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Confirm which date field to filter (e.g., created-vs-close semantics), confirm stage meaning, and set UTC start/end boundaries before querying using SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY (avoid timezone/off-by-one issues).

[Optional (if stage label/record-type mapping is uncertain)] [Prerequisite]: Resolve valid stage picklist values using SALESFORCE_GET_PICKLIST_VALUES_BY_RECORD_TYPE (prevents silent zero-result filters).
[Required] [Step]: Retrieve matching opportunities using SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY (filter by date range + StageName; select only needed fields; order by date for stable paging).

[Optional (if totals look off or you need counts)] [Step]: Cross-check with an aggregate GROUP BY StageName query using SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY (COUNT and optional SUM) to validate coverage and refine filters.

[Optional (if large/partial result set)] [Next Step]: Check headroom using SALESFORCE_GET_ORG_LIMITS, then paginate SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY using the query locator/nextRecordsUrl until all rows are collected.
[Optional (if you need richer fields in bulk)] [Next Step]: Enrich many records via SALESFORCE_GET_UI_API_RECORDS_BATCH, and spot-check specific rows with SALESFORCE_GET_OPPORTUNITY.
[Fallback (if SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY returns unexpected empties/missing rows)] [Fallback]: Re-run equivalent SOQL using SALESFORCE_QUERY_ALL to include wider query scope.
known_pitfalls: [SALESFORCE_SEARCH_OPPORTUNITIES] Using close-date style constraints when the intent is created-date filtering can yield empty/incorrect results.
[SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY] GROUP BY returns AggregateResult rows (not opportunity rows) and count/sum fields may appear under alias keys.
[SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY] Relationship selects return nested objects; downstream logic must null-check nested Name fields and ignore attributes wrappers.
[SALESFORCE_GET_PICKLIST_VALUES_BY_RECORD_TYPE] StageName matching is exact; label/near-match guesses often return totalSize=0 without an explicit error.

[SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY] If the real intent is “entered a stage within the window,” filtering on CreatedDate + StageName will not capture stage transitions (history-style queries can also error depending on org config).

toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=salesforce. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="salesforce") to create a connection BEFORE executing any salesforce tools.

SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY.description: Executes a SOQL query against Salesforce data. Returns records matching the query with pagination support.

examples: SELECT Id, Name, Email FROM Contact WHERE CreatedDate > 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z
SELECT Name, (SELECT LastName FROM Contacts) FROM Account
SELECT COUNT() FROM Lead WHERE Status = 'New'
SELECT COUNT(Id), StageName FROM Opportunity GROUP BY StageName
SELECT Id, Name FROM Opportunity ORDER BY Amount DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT Id, Name FROM Contact WHERE LastName = 'O\'Brien'
SELECT Id, Name, Description FROM Account LIMIT 10
query.description: SOQL query to execute. Must start with SELECT. Field names must match object schema exactly — use SALESFORCE_GET_ALL_FIELDS_FOR_OBJECT for unfamiliar objects. ALIASES: No 'AS' keyword (use 'SUM(Amount) TotalSales' NOT 'SUM(Amount) AS TotalSales'). AGGREGATES: Without GROUP BY, ORDER BY/LIMIT not allowed (single-row result). COUNT() SYNTAX: Bare COUNT() only valid alone. With GROUP BY or other fields, must specify field: COUNT(Id) or COUNT(fieldName). Example: 'SELECT COUNT(Id), Status FROM Lead GROUP BY Status' NOT 'SELECT COUNT(), Status FROM Lead GROUP BY Status'. NON-GROUPABLE: Long text, rich text, encrypted text, compound address/location fields. NON-FILTERABLE: Long text area, rich text, encrypted text, multi-select picklists, blob fields CANNOT be in WHERE. FIELDS(ALL)/FIELDS(CUSTOM) require LIMIT ≤200. ID values need single quotes. Apostrophes use backslash: 'O\'Brien'.

SALESFORCE_SEARCH_OPPORTUNITIES.description: Search for Salesforce opportunities using multiple criteria like name, account, stage, amount, close date, or status. Apply at least one filter to avoid broad result sets. Partial-match searches may return multiple similar records; verify the correct record by Id before downstream use.

name.description: Search by opportunity name. Supports partial matches.

limit.description: Maximum number of opportunities to return. Maximum value is 2000. When totalSize in the response exceeds limit, use nextRecordsUrl to paginate through the full dataset.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of Opportunity fields to retrieve. Supports direct Opportunity fields (e.g., Id, Name, Amount) and parent relationship fields (e.g., Account.Name, Owner.Name). Note: Contact.* fields (Contact.Name, Contact.Email, etc.) are NOT valid because Opportunity does not have a direct parent relationship to Contact; use OpportunityContactRole queries to get contact information. Parent relationship fields like Account.Name may be null on returned records; guard against missing nested values when post-processing.

is_won.description: Filter by won status. True for won opportunities, False for lost (only applies to closed opportunities).

is_closed.description: Filter by closed status. True for closed opportunities, False for open.

account_name.description: Search by associated account name. Supports partial matches.

close_date_to.description: Search opportunities with close date before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

close_date_from.description: Search opportunities with close date from this date (YYYY-MM-DD). When computing relative ranges (e.g., 'this week'), derive dates using the user's local timezone to avoid off-by-one-day errors.

SALESFORCE_GET_PICKLIST_VALUES_BY_RECORD.description: Tool to get values for all picklist fields of a record type, including dependent picklists. Use when you need to retrieve available picklist options for a specific object and record type, especially for dependent picklist hierarchies.

record_type_id.description: The 18-character Record Type ID. Use '012000000000000AAA' for objects without record types (default record type).

sobject_api_name.description: The API name of the Salesforce object (e.g., 'Account', 'Contact', 'Opportunity', or custom object like 'Car__c').

SALESFORCE_QUERY_ALL.description: Tool to execute SOQL queries including soft-deleted and archived records. Use when you need to query...

SALESFORCE_GET_OPPORTUNITY.description: Retrieves a specific opportunity by ID from Salesforce, returning all available fields.

SALESFORCE_GET_ORG_LIMITS.description: Tool to retrieve organization limits with max and remaining allocations. Use when you need to check ...
